address: 115 Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre, #01-30, Blk 115 Bukit Merah View, 151115, Singapore
bio: Not to be confused with the western sweet of the same name, carrot cake here is savoury, made with radish and stir-fried in seasoning. Opt for the dark version coated in egg, and tossed in sticky, caramelised dark soy sauce....
